messages: Carla: Heads-up: Docusaurus linkcheck + MDX parse failing on guides/setup.mdx. Error shows an unexpected token and a broken anchor to ops/cache. Snippet below. Carla: ``` MDXParseError: Unexpected token at docs/guides/setup.mdx: line 58 linkcheck: ../ops/cache#warm-start -> anchor not found ``` Ben: Can you paste the minimal surrounding lines? trying to repro locally. Carla: In setup.mdx there's a fenced code example demonstrating a CONTRIBUTING pattern. It contains a literal admonition marker inside the fence: Carla: ``` ```bash # example snippet copied from CONTRIBUTING.md cat < `warm-starting`). Alice: Yep, seen similar. Parser sometimes lifts admonition markers unless they're escaped or the fence language prevents MDX processing. Options: 1) escape the colons (e.g. `:\:\:note`) 2) move the admonition outside the fenced block 3) add an explicit header id on the target page `## Warm starting {#warm-start}`. For backports the explicit id is lowest risk. Greg: Another tiny shim is to add a raw HTML anchor below the heading: ``. Works across older Docusaurus versions. Ben: I'll take this. Plan: a) replace the referencing link to the canonical slug `../ops/cache/#warm-starting` b) rewrite the example so the admonition is shown as escaped text inside the fence (or add a comment wrapper) c) run local linkcheck: `PYTHONPATH=. python -m scripts.linkcheck docs` then push. ci-bot: Note: we've seen false negatives locally due to cached actions/cache. If CI linkcheck still fails after local success, clear the build cache or bump the cache key. Ben: Implemented branch `docs/fix/escape-admonition-1755`. For minimal churn on release branches I'll add the HTML id shim in a separate backport PR. Pushed and ran local linkcheck 10: all green locally. docs-bot: Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4407 - Docusaurus: fix MDX admonition in fenced example, normalize ops/cache anchor. Carla: Thanks. Can you open `release/v1.x` backport with just the anchor id shim? We have customers referencing that branch. Ben: Will open `backport/docs-1755` after merge. Alice: Also adding a tiny CONTRIBUTING appendix: "When pasting examples that contain raw admonition markers, either escape the colons or wrap the example in a code block language that prevents MDX parsing. See examples." Saves future flakiness. Greg: And maybe add a short troubleshooting note in docs-ci about clearing the actions cache when linkcheck passes locally but CI fails. Carla: Sounds good. Closing when backport lands. :tada:
